hook.text: Every advisor in the room agreed the Bay of Pigs invasion would succeed. Nobody dared disagree with Kennedy.

buildup.text: Groupthink occurs when a group prioritizes harmony and consensus over accurate analysis.

discovery.text: Irving Janis identified it after studying policy disasters—unanimous agreement despite obvious warning signs.

twist.text: The smarter and more cohesive the group, the more vulnerable it is. Trust breeds silence.

climax.text: Assign a devil's advocate. Invite outsiders. Reward dissent. Break the illusion of consensus.
